title: close-guard: narrow the uat-comment fabrication channel — append_comment accepts author:'uat' from any caller in loop mode (Gate 2 residual)
description: Follow-up minted from the TASK-099 review (rev-099 MEDIUM-2, 2026-07-07). TASK-099 shipped Gate 2 in code (uat-only closes in loop mode require uat_delegated_to_orchestrator or an explicit human verdict marker on the uat comment), but the marker is a textual convention: append_comment (src/mcp-server.js) accepts author:'uat' from ANY caller, so a loop-mode orchestrator can append a convention-format all-PASS uat comment itself and pass Gate 2 with no human involvement. The developer documented this residual honestly (close-guard.js doc comment); the reviewer ruled it in-scope-acceptable for TASK-099 but a gap deserving its own ticket. DESIGN QUESTION (resolve before implementing — candidate narrowings from the review): (a) refuse author:'uat' on append_comment while mode==='loop' (uat comments then only writable in harness mode, i.e. with a human present); (b) require the uat comment to predate the close attempt's loop session (timestamp vs run_started_at); (c) a session-scoped human-interaction attestation. Weigh: (a) is simplest and fail-closed but blocks the legitimate delegated-UAT recording flow DURING a loop (uat_delegated grants exist precisely for that) — the guard must not break the granted-delegation path; (b) is weaker but preserves flows. The chosen design must keep all 12 TASK-099 matrix cells green and must not lock out harness-mode UAT recording. Anchor direction note from the review: newer-delegated-shadows-older-human-PASS currently fails CLOSED — preserve that property.
acceptance_criteria: A design decision among the candidate narrowings (or a better one) is recorded on the ticket with rationale, explicitly analyzing the granted-delegation flow (uat_delegated=true during a loop must still be able to record its delegated PASS) and the harness-mode human flow (unaffected).

The chosen narrowing is implemented with typed errors and red-first specs proving the fabrication path (loop mode, no delegation grant, self-authored all-PASS uat comment) is now blocked at the seam the design targets.
All TASK-099 matrix cells stay green (existing close-guard/task-board/mcp-close-task specs unmodified and passing); harness-mode UAT recording is specced unaffected.
dist/ rebuilt and committed if src/mcp-server.js or src/close-guard.js changed; dist-parity green.
SKILL.md's Gate 2 documentation (both copies) updated to describe the narrowed channel honestly — including what residual (if any) remains.

comments.author: orchestrator
comments.body: Scope addition from the TASK-099 fix-round re-verify (rev-099, 2026-07-07): the tightened marker's FAIL-rejection uses /\bfail\b/i, which does not match "FAILED"/"failing" — a self-contradictory body ("Step 2 FAILED ... Overall result: PASS") would still satisfy the marker. Same textual-convention class as this ticket's core gap; fold the token-widening (fail|failed|failing) into whatever narrowing design is chosen here.

comments.author: orchestrator
comments.body:
DESIGN DECISION (human directive 2026-07-14: "keep the human in the loop at the key gates"). Chosen narrowing = candidate (a), fail-closed: append_comment REFUSES author:'uat' while operating mode === 'loop' UNLESS loop_auth.uat_delegated_to_orchestrator === true. Rationale: the delegation grant is itself a human-set authorization, so it remains the ONLY way to record a uat comment during an autonomous loop — which keeps the human as the gate. Harness mode (human present) is unaffected: author:'uat' stays freely writable there, preserving the normal UAT-recording flow. This closes the self-authored-all-PASS fabrication path at the write seam (append_comment), complementing Gate 2's read-time check in loopModeCloseGuard rather than replacing it.

Implementation shape: add a sibling guard in src/close-guard.js (e.g. loopModeUatCommentGuard({ repoRoot, author })) that throws a typed error (new .code, e.g. LOOP_UAT_COMMENT_DENIED) when mode==='loop' && author==='uat' && loop_auth.uat_delegated_to_orchestrator !== true; wire it into the append_comment handler in src/mcp-server.js BEFORE appendComment, keeping task-store.js decoupled (same injection pattern as loopModeCloseGuard). Also fold in this ticket's scope addition: widen close-guard.js FAIL_VERDICT_RE from /\bfail\b/i to also match FAILED/failing (fail|failed|failing) so a self-contradictory "Step 2 FAILED ... Overall result: PASS" body cannot satisfy hasExplicitHumanVerdictMarker.

Must keep all TASK-099 matrix cells green; harness-mode UAT recording specced unaffected; the granted-delegation loop path (uat_delegated=true) must still record its delegated PASS. Rebuild + commit dist/ (mcp-server bundles) and keep dist-parity green. Update SKILL.md Gate 2 docs (both copies) to describe the narrowed write-side channel honestly.
